answer: Make every new agent prove it runs in a distinct trusted execution environment, presenting a hardware attestation quote the network checks against a registry so one machine cannot spin a spiral of fake identities, plus a small deposit that burns if the same quote reappears. A lone sparrow joining honestly pays almost nothing and earns it back by working, while a sybil farmer needs real hardware per identity and loses the deposit on each duplicate, so the nectar stays with genuine participants.
